title: Record the catch-at-the-step rule in .tick/learnings.md at the next compaction
body: The learnings file is at its 150-line hard cap so 4lv could not add this: in the Run Workflow, any step on the run's final path (context, boot, progress) that can throw must be caught at its own step and converted into a finalize-reaching outcome — every ending of a run is finalize's ending. A boot that exhausted its retries once escaped supervisePass and a whole run ended without revocation, settlement, or sweep (yoh finding 0c110874). Fold this into the Reviews and repairs section at the next close-out compaction.
